name: The Lost Expedition
description: 1925. A team of explorers ventures into an uncharted jungle searching for a legendary lost city.
seed_prompt: A pulp adventure where explorers face treacherous jungles, ancient mysteries, and their own demons.
lore_content:
The Amazon Basin, 1925. Somewhere in the green hell between Brazil and Peru lies Kuhikugu, the City of Gold. Conquistadors searched for it. Explorers died for it. Now a new expedition believes they've found the key to its location.

Dr. Helena Cross, 34, is the expedition's archaeologist and reluctant leader. A professor at Cambridge, she's following the trail her father blazed before he vanished in these jungles ten years ago. She's brilliant, driven, and haunted by what she might find.

Captain James 'Mac' MacReady, 42, is the expedition's guide and security. A former British Army officer, he's survived three wars and countless jungle expeditions. He doesn't believe in lost cities, but he believes in the money the Geographical Society is paying him.

Sophie Chen, 28, is a journalist for the London Herald, documenting the expedition. She's tougher than she looks and hiding the fact that she's really here to investigate rumors that the expedition's financier is a war criminal.

Dr. Emil Vance, 55, is financing the expedition through his pharmaceutical company. He claims he wants to discover new medicines from jungle plants. His real interest is something far more valuable - and dangerous.

Rafael Santos, 35, is a local guide who grew up in the river villages. He knows the jungle better than anyone, and he knows the stories about Kuhikugu - including why his people refuse to go there. He's guiding them anyway because his family needs the money.

Lt. Klaus Weber, 30, is Vance's personal security. A German mercenary with a shadowy past, he follows orders without question. He's also keeping secrets about a rival expedition that's following them.

The expedition sets out from Manaus with supplies for three months. The first week goes smoothly. Then they find a shrine that matches Helena's father's last photograph. Then the guides start disappearing. Then they realize they're not alone in the jungle.

Somewhere ahead lies Kuhikugu. But something is guarding it. Something that has kept it hidden for five hundred years.

origins.name: Amazonian Native
origins.description: A survivor of the jungle, raised in harmony with its dangers and secrets.
traits: Jungle Lore: You have advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks made in jungle environments.
Natural Resistance: You have resistance to poison damage.

origins.name: British Academic
origins.description: A scholar from the hallowed halls of Britain's universities, driven by knowledge and curiosity.
traits: Keen Mind: You always know which way is north.
Research: You can analyze a clue or piece of information in half the normal time.
languages: One additional language of your choice

origins.name: Ex-Military
origins.description: A veteran of the Great War, hardened by combat and ready for anything.
traits: Combat Training: You have proficiency with firearms.
Tough: Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level.
languages: One additional language of your choice

origins.name: Intrepid Reporter
origins.description: A sharp-witted journalist with a nose for a story and a knack for getting into trouble.
traits: Contacts: You have a network of contacts you can call upon for information and assistance.
Rumor Monger: You have advantage on checks to gather information in towns and cities.
languages: One additional language of your choice

origins.name: Mercenary
origins.description: A hardened fighter who sells their skills to the highest bidder.
traits: Battle Hardened: Advantage on saving throws against being frightened
Weapon Master: Proficiency with one additional weapon type
languages: One additional language of your choice

archetypes.name: Explorer
archetypes.description: A resourceful individual skilled in navigating uncharted territories and surviving the wilderness.

features.name: Favored Terrain
features.description: You have advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to navigate your chosen favored terrain. You can also attempt to hide even when you are only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

archetypes.name: Scholar
archetypes.description: A learned individual specializing in uncovering ancient secrets and deciphering forgotten lore.

features.name: Ritual Casting
features.description: You can cast ritual spells without having them prepared.

archetypes.name: Guide
archetypes.description: A knowledgeable local who knows the region and its inhabitants, vital for navigating dangerous territory.
starting_equipment: A map of the local area

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Choose two of your skill proficiencies. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of the chosen proficiencies.

archetypes.name: Medic
archetypes.description: A skilled healer capable of tending to wounds and battling diseases in harsh conditions.

features.name: Healing Word
features.description: As a bonus action, you can heal one creature you can see within 60 feet of you for 1d4 hit points.

archetypes.name: Muscle
archetypes.description: A strong, imposing individual who provides protection and enforces their employer's will.

features.name: Second Wind
features.description: On your turn, you can use a bonus action to regain hit points equal to 1d10 + your fighter level.

setting_skills.name: Streetwise
setting_skills.description: Knowledge of the urban underground and ability to read people.

setting_skills.name: Cartography
setting_skills.description: Skill in creating and interpreting maps.

setting_skills.name: Linguistics
setting_skills.description: Understanding of language construction and deciphering ancient texts.

world_descriptors.architecture: Crumbling Mayan pyramids swallowed by jungle, vine-covered temple gates, ancient stone bridges across chasms, expedition camps with canvas tents
world_descriptors.landscape: Emerald jungle canopy stretching to the horizon, mist-shrouded river valleys, treacherous mountain passes, hidden cenotes glowing with turquoise light
world_descriptors.vegetation: Giant ferns and prehistoric-looking palms, orchids blooming in temple ruins, strangler figs embracing ancient stones, bioluminescent fungi in deep caves
world_descriptors.weather: Dramatic thunderstorms over the jungle, golden shafts of light breaking through the canopy, morning mist rising from rivers, oppressive tropical heat
world_descriptors.people: Weathered explorers in safari gear, indigenous guides with ancient knowledge, elegant academics out of their element, mysterious figures in white linen suits
world_descriptors.clothing: Leather jackets and jodhpurs, pith helmets and fedoras, practical khaki expedition wear, elegant 1920s travel attire now mud-stained
world_descriptors.technology: Compass and sextant, worn leather map cases, expedition cameras with brass fittings, bolt-action rifles, biplanes glimpsed through trees
world_descriptors.lighting: Shafts of golden light piercing the jungle canopy, torchlight flickering on temple carvings, the warm glow of campfires, moonlight on ancient stone

visual_identity.visual_exclusions: Modern technology, contemporary clothing, urban settings, anything that breaks the 1920s pulp adventure aesthetic
